effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
[All Turns] While [Leomon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
